title: CLAT Practice Set 2
pageDesc: Free CLAT practice paper set 2 with detailed solutions.

questions.text: The Government announces a policy to regularize all ad-hoc employees with 10 years of service. Relying on this, an employee declines a private job offer. Before regularization, the Government withdraws the policy citing fiscal constraints, without hearing the employee. The employee challenges the withdrawal. Which principle governs the outcome?

options.label: A
options.text: The employee has a substantive right to regularization because the policy created a legitimate expectation enforceable as a contract.

options.label: B
options.text: The withdrawal is valid because legitimate expectation is merely a moral claim with no legal enforceability against the State.

options.label: C
options.text: The withdrawal is invalid because legitimate expectation requires a hearing before frustration, unless overriding public interest is shown, which mere fiscal constraints may not satisfy.

options.label: D
options.text: The employee can claim damages for breach of promise under promissory estoppel, but cannot compel regularization.

questions.solution: Correct answer: The withdrawal is invalid because legitimate expectation requires a hearing before frustration, unless overriding public interest is shown, which mere fiscal constraints may not satisfy..

questions.text: According to the lesson, what is the typical function of the final paragraph in a contemporary RC passage?

options.label: A
options.text: To introduce the central issue and define key terms

options.label: B
options.text: To present the author's personal biography and credentials

options.label: C
options.text: To offer a synthesis, recommendation, or forward-looking observation

options.label: D
options.text: To list all the sources and references cited in the passage

questions.solution: Correct answer: To offer a synthesis, recommendation, or forward-looking observation.

questions.text: Which group of countries was added to BRICS during its 2024 expansion?

options.label: A
options.text: Argentina, Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, Saudi Arabia

options.label: B
options.text: Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, UAE, Saudi Arabia

questions.solution: Correct answer: Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, UAE, Saudi Arabia.

questions.text: A constitutional amendment is challenged on the ground that it destroys the federal character of the Constitution by converting States into mere administrative units. The Supreme Court strikes down the amendment. Which maxim correctly captures the legal consequence and the doctrinal basis for this outcome?

options.label: A
options.text: The amendment is voidable under the doctrine of eclipse, as it is inconsistent with fundamental rights.

options.label: B
options.text: The amendment is void ab initio under the basic structure doctrine, as it violates constitutional supremacy.

options.label: C
options.text: The amendment is ultra vires the legislative competence of Parliament under Article 368.

options.label: D
options.text: The amendment is intra vires but inoperative under the principle of severability until the federal structure is restored.

questions.solution: Correct answer: The amendment is void ab initio under the basic structure doctrine, as it violates constitutional supremacy..

questions.text: Premises: (1) All poets are dreamers. (2) Some dreamers are writers. Which conclusion follows?

options.label: A
options.text: No one should be a judge in their own case

options.label: C
options.text: Ignorance of law is no excuse

options.label: D
options.text: To a willing person, no injury

questions.solution: Correct answer: No one should be a judge in their own case.

questions.text: A law passed by Parliament prohibits all forms of religious procession in public spaces. A citizen challenges this law claiming it violates their Fundamental Right to Freedom of Religion. What is the likely outcome?

options.label: A
options.text: The law will be upheld as it is a reasonable restriction.

options.label: B
options.text: The law will be struck down as it violates Article 25/27 (Freedom of Religion).

options.label: C
options.text: The court will refer the matter to Parliament for review.

options.label: D
options.text: The citizen has no right to challenge a Parliamentary law.

questions.solution: Correct answer: The law will be struck down as it violates Article 25/27 (Freedom of Religion)..

questions.text: Premise: All managers are leaders. Which of the following conclusions follows necessarily?
questions.solution: Correct answer: Some leaders are managers.

questions.text: Data interpretation answers must be based on:
questions.solution: Correct answer: The given data only.

questions.text: Which of the following legal terms best describes a situation where a person is prevented from denying something they previously admitted to in court?
Complete the letter series: Z, Y, X, W, ?
Premises: (1) No cats are dogs. (2) Some dogs are pets. Which conclusion is valid?
questions.solution: Correct answer: Some pets are not cats.
